name: Institutional Knowledge Archivist
description: Preserve a departing senior leader's institutional knowledge — decisions, rationale, relationships, and tribal knowledge — by mining their M365 signals into a structured, multi-phase archive a successor can ground on.
author: Srinivas Varukala
coverImageAlt: Smooth knowledge ribbons flow from a tree-ring memory disc into a blank structured archive.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: Luminous strands carrying decisions, relationships, and hard-won context flow from a weathered tree-ring memory disc into a structured archival vault, a single clear metaphor for preserving a departing leader's institutional knowledge for a successor.
Scene/backdrop: An uncluttered warm-paper archival work surface with a centered slate inset, no office scenery and no interface.
Subject: One tactile tree-ring disc, several smooth continuous cyan knowledge ribbons with no nodes or marks, and one orderly navy archive vault with blank compartments, joined into a compact central handoff composition with one smooth orange continuity ribbon.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, warm wood grain, woven threads, matte ceramic, and translucent glass layers
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered three-quarter view at a smaller scale; the full disc, every unbroken ribbon, complete archive vault, platform, and all shadows contained within the central 68% of the frame; leave at least 16% calm empty border on all four sides; no object may enter the outer 12%; bold silhouette legible at small card size
Lighting/mood: calm, respectful, enduring, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting and soft directional shadows
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no floating nodes, circles, rosettes, glyphs, flowers, clusters, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, labels, names, portraits, symbols, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI, no Microsoft Fluent gradients, and no Microsoft branding; all ribbons, archive compartments, and visible surfaces must remain blank and unmarked
